name: Immich (photos)
summary: Photos and videos: automatic phone backup, albums, sharing, a map and search by what's in a photo

options.label: Photos and videos folder
options.help: On a share, so that the originals can also be reached over SMB. Immich manages everything in it (originals, thumbnails, converted videos and its database backups) - use a new, empty folder, not your existing photos.

options.label: Existing photo folders
options.help: Photos you already keep in folders on the NAS - e.g. one per family member. Immich shows them too, read only: it never moves, renames or deletes anything there, and you keep organising them over SMB as before. After installing, add each one in Immich: Administration -> External Libraries.

options.label: Face recognition
options.help: Finding faces and grouping them into people. It's the heaviest of Immich's machine learning on the NAS's CPU. Once installed, it's changed in Immich's own settings (Administration -> Settings -> Machine Learning Settings).

options.label: Immich version
options.help: Which Immich releases to follow - updated when the Store updates the recipe, or with docker compose pull.
